Files and folders are used through handles. [ReadFile](ReadFile), [WriteFile](WriteFile) and [OpenFile](OpenFile) give you a file handle that you must close with [CloseFile](CloseFile) when you are done, and [ReadDir](ReadDir) gives a folder handle for [CloseDir](CloseDir). What you read and write through a file handle is described on [[BlitzBasic-Streams]]. Paths may use `/` on every platform, and are relative to the current folder unless they are complete.
